sources.snippet: zipformer2-66m-streaming-he Streaming Hebrew speech recognition: a 66 M-parameter Zipformer2 transducer, fine-tuned from icefall's English streaming Zipformer on ivrit.ai Hebrew audio. Decodes in 1.28 s chunks as audio arrives.

sources.snippet: The sherpa-onnx int8 export scores 5.3 / 8.8. Additional ONNX exports (onnx/) Added by ivrit.ai to Yakov Kolani's model. The original repo ships only the int8 sherpa-onnx export; these are full-precision exports of the same model.pt, with identical inputs and outputs (drop-in for sherpa-onnx or onnxruntime).
